truth_evidence: Affected 2.3.0 to 2.30.0; fixed in 2.31.0 (Proxy-Authorization sent to the destination on an https redirect through a proxy).
Fix commit 74ea7cf 'Merge pull request from GHSA-j8r2-6x86-q33q', in tag v2.31.0 and not in v2.30.0. https://github.com/psf/requests/commit/74ea7cf7a6a27a4eeb2ae24e162bcc942a6706d5
rebuild_proxies: 'if username and password' becomes 'if not scheme.startswith("https") and username and password' before adding the Proxy-Authorization header.
Entry points: resolve_redirects calls rebuild_proxies on every redirect; rebuild_proxies is a public Session method.
